title: All Uub'd Up and Ready To Go!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: So you're saying you're only here because your family's poor and you need the money?

lines.speaker: Uub
lines.text: Yes, I spent all the remaining money on a plane ticket here.

lines.speaker: Uub
lines.text: Please let me win, or we are literally going to die.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: What I'm hearing is I need to abandon my life at home and spend the next couple of years training you how to punch well good.

lines.speaker: Uub
lines.text: My mother has not eaten in days.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Already on it! They will never know hardship again.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Man, I'm glad all the people with money use it for good.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I know this is probably tough to hear, but-

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh no, it's cool. Have fun!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Of course! We've had you home for a decade now! If anything, a little much.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, you heard him! Come on, Boo!
